blurb: Vertical View is a world-class climbing gym and outdoor adventure course in Meridian, Idaho. With some of the tallest climbing walls in the country, a full Olympic speed wall, a multi-level ropes course, yoga and fitness classes, and youth programs, we offer something for every age and ability.
